stances.summary: Calls for removal of Republicans protecting child predators
stances.quote: It’s a little late for elected Republicans to take a moral high ground. Overwhelmingly, they have rallied to protect rich child sexual predators. Raping children was once considered the worst of the worst. Clean them all out, from the White House, to the Senate, to the House.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump pardons for January 6 attackers, warns of election disruption
stances.quote:
Trump is giving your taxpayer dollars to violent criminals who attacked police on Jan 6. He says "in my world, loyalty outranks law. They broke the rules for me."

This is insane.

He's getting geared up to create more chaos to try to stop you from voting.

He underestimates us.

stances.summary: Explains voting rights protections, implies concern about southern voting law changes
stances.quote:

stances.summary: Expresses concern about protecting America's promise for future generations
stances.quote: My beautiful, smart, kind, and caring granddaughter on Prom Night. She believes in the promise of America but we must continue to fight for it.
